title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 17: sin written with a pen of iron, the cursed bush and the blessed tree, the deceitful heart, and keeping the Sabbath holy.

questions.text: With what is the sin of Judah written?
questions.explanation: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron and with the point of a diamond; it is engraved on the tablet of their heart and on the horns of your altars.

answers.text: With ink on a scroll of parchment
With blood on the doorposts of the houses
With a pen of iron and the point of a diamond
With a reed pen on tablets of clay

questions.text: Who is cursed, according to Yahweh in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh."

answers.text: The man who trusts in man and relies on strength of flesh
The man who swears a false oath by Yahweh's name
The man who mocks the prophets and the elders
The man who serves two masters at one time

questions.text: What will the man who trusts in man be like?
questions.explanation: He will be like a bush in the desert and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.

answers.text: Like chaff driven by the wind
Like a bush in the desert
Like a broken cistern
Like a withered vine

questions.text: What will the man who trusts in Yahweh be like?
questions.explanation: The blessed man who trusts in Yahweh will be as a tree planted by the waters that spreads its roots by the river; its leaf stays green and it won't cease yielding fruit.

answers.text: Like an eagle renewing its wings
Like a city set on a hill
Like a spring whose waters never end
Like a tree planted by the waters

questions.text: What does this chapter say about the heart?
questions.explanation: The text says, "The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?"

answers.text: It is pure in the righteous and the upright
It is deceitful above all things and exceedingly corrupt
It is a lamp that gives light to the whole body
It is hardened like stone against instruction

questions.text: To which bird is the man who gets riches not by right compared?
questions.explanation: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right; in the middle of his days they will leave him.

answers.text: The partridge sitting on eggs she has not laid
The raven that gathers no harvest
The stork that forgets her nest
The vulture circling the slain

questions.text: What will happen to those who depart from Yahweh, the spring of living waters?
questions.explanation: All who forsake Yahweh will be disappointed, and those who depart from Him will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the spring of living waters.

answers.text: They will be cast into the fire
They will thirst forever
They will be written in the earth
They will wander among the nations

questions.text: What does the speaker pray in this chapter?
questions.explanation: He prays, "Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise."

answers.text: "Teach me your statutes and your ways"
"Give me a new heart and a right spirit"
"Remember your covenant with your servant David"
"Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed"

questions.text: What are the people commanded not to do on the Sabbath day?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says to bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem, nor carry a burden out of their houses, but to make the Sabbath day holy.

answers.text: Bear a burden or carry one out of their houses
Buy grain or goods from the foreigners
Light a fire in any of their dwellings
Travel beyond the walls of the city

questions.text: What will happen if they do not listen and still bear burdens through the gates on the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: If they will not listen, Yahweh will kindle a fire in Jerusalem's gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem and will not be quenched.

answers.text: The gates of the city will be shut forever
A fire will be kindled in its gates, not to be quenched
The kings will lose the throne of David forever
The land will no longer give its harvest
